examples.arabic: الزيارة كانت حلوة بس فيه فرق كبير
examples.english: The visit was nice but there is a big difference.
examples.transliteration: El ziyara kanet helwa bas fi'h far' kibeer.

examples.arabic: كانت زيارة حلوة اوي وبعدين مشيت ومع السلامة
examples.english: It was a very nice visit and then I left, goodbye.
examples.transliteration: Kanet ziyara helwa awi w ba'dein mesheet w ma'a salama.

examples.arabic: لما بكون مبسوط بكلم اصحابي بعد الزيارة
examples.english: When I am happy, I talk to my friends after the visit.
examples.transliteration: Lama bakoon mabsoot bakallem ashabi ba'd elziyara

examples.english: It was a sweet and beautiful visit.
